newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: ADRIA AIRWAYS 7-MO PASSENGER NUMBERS UP SIX PCT.
newsitem.headline: ADRIA AIRWAYS 7-MO PASSENGER NUMBERS UP SIX PCT.

text.p: Slovenia's state-owned airline Adria Airways said on Wednesday it had increased the number of its passengers by six percent in the first seven months of this year compared to the same period a year ago.
Adria Airways carried a total 348,600 passengers in the first seven months.
In July the number of passengers using the services of Slovenia's only airline rose to 79,000 -- a five percent increase compared to July 1996, the airline said in a statement.
The company said traffic on scheduled lines firmed only one percent, while the number of passengers on charter flights jumped 15 percent. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
